explication: Ant Design is a React UI component library for enterprise web applications. A consumer imports components, wraps them in optional configuration, supplies props and state, and receives rendered, interactive browser UI. The principal stages are public exports, configuration and theming, component behavior, and presentation. Sampled source confirms context-based configuration, CSS-in-JS theme creation, App-level feedback holders, image-preview normalization, and stateful Transfer behavior. The tree also documents broad input, navigation, feedback, layout, and data-display capabilities; some component internals were not sampled.
